author: The Infographics Show
description:
You were told you’d live longer than your parents, but the data says the opposite.
For millions of Americans, life expectancy is stalling, or even reversing.

The reality is uncomfortable. Despite world-class hospitals like Mayo Clinic and MD Anderson Cancer Center, the system isn’t built to keep people healthy, it’s built to treat them once they’re already sick. The U.S. spends more on healthcare than almost any country, yet still falls behind nations like Japan and Switzerland in life expectancy.

At the same time, everyday life is quietly working against you.
Ultra-processed food dominates diets, movement has been engineered out of daily routines, and chronic stress is accelerating aging at a biological level.
Add rising “deaths of despair” from overdoses, alcohol, and mental health struggles, and a disturbing pattern starts to emerge.

And here’s the harshest truth - longevity is no longer equal.

title: 14.7 Million Dead. Millennials Are DOOMED
